title: Programming-pattern practice exercises
summary: CS1 students complete eight ungraded Python exercises by translating step-by-step programming-pattern comments into code and submitting to CodeRunner. Students have unlimited attempts; the paper evaluates how readily GitHub Copilot can solve the same briefs and generate tests and explanations.

sources.title: Using GitHub Copilot to Solve Simple Programming Problems
sources.evidence_quote: Students write the corresponding code line(s) after each comment. CodeRunner runs some tests and presents the results. Students have unlimited attempts: the exercises aren't graded.
